hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.go) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; out=$( { gofmt -l "$f"; (cd "$(dirname "$f")" && go vet . 2>&1); } 2>&1 ); [ -z "$out" ] || jq -n --arg m "$out" '{decision:"block",reason:("gofmt -l / go vet reported:\n"+$m)}'; }
